title: HomeRefill: 187.5K accounts breached
summary: In April 2020, now defunct Brazilian e-commerce platform HomeRefill suffered a data breach that was later redistributed as part of a larger corpus of data. The data included 187k unique email addresses along with names, phone numbers, dates of birth and salted password hashes.

title: Latest Pilot Jobs: 118.9K accounts breached
